ignore_ambient.description: Skip PATH/HOME/CI and similar vars every environment provides.
ignore_ambient.title: Ignore Ambient

report_set_never_read.description: Report vars set in env files that no supplied source reads. Turn off when passing a partial source set, where absence proves nothing.
report_set_never_read.title: Report Set Never Read

prefix_filter.description: Only consider variables starting with this prefix, e.g. 'MYAPP_'. Sharpens the report on a codebase with many third-party vars.
prefix_filter.title: Prefix Filter
